label: Tomato___Early_blight
warning: Confidence is a model score, not diagnostic accuracy. Controlled leaf datasets may not generalize to field images.

guidance.description: Early blight is a fungal disease that can affect tomato leaves, stems and fruit.
guidance.symptoms: Older leaves may develop brown lesions with concentric rings and surrounding yellowing.
guidance.prevention: Use healthy transplants, rotate away from susceptible crops, and reduce prolonged leaf wetness.
guidance.consult: Consult your local agricultural extension service when symptoms spread, plants wilt, or the result is uncertain.

testNote: Single public PlantVillage image smoke test, potentially seen by the pretrained model; not held-out evaluation or accuracy.
